Kanjabana furakɛli:Kanjabanakánjabananméningitekánncoujàvsécherbànanmaladie furakɛlifúrakɛlintraitementfúrakɛvsoignerfúranfeuillekɛ́vfairelimrphNMLZ :

Kanjabana furakɛ joona.Kanjabanakánjabananméningitekánncoujàvsécherbànanmaladie furakɛfúrakɛvsoignerfúranfeuillekɛ́vfaire joonajóonaadvbientôt . A furakɛli la, i bɛ anpisilini <c>(ampicilline</c>) sɔgɔli dɔ kɛ a la ani zantamisini (<c>gentamicine)</c> sɔgɔli dɔ ɲɛ Kunfinnin ni zantamisini<c>, l'ampicilline et la gentamicine</c> lajɛ.Aàpers3SG furakɛlifúrakɛlintraitementfúrakɛvsoignerfúranfeuillekɛ́vfairelimrphNMLZ laláppà , iípers2SG bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF anpisilinianpisilininampicilline <c>(ampicilline</c> ) sɔgɔlisɔ̀gɔlinsɔ̀gɔvpercerlimrphNMLZ dɔdɔ́dtmcertain kɛkɛ́vfaire aàpers3SG laláppà aniàníconjainsi.que zantamisinizantamisiningentamycine ( <c>gentamicine)</c> sɔgɔlisɔ̀gɔlinsɔ̀gɔvpercerlimrphNMLZ dɔdɔ́dtmcertain ɲɛɲɛ́noeil KunfinninkùnfinninnampicillinekùnntêtefìnadjnoirninmrphDIM niniconjet zantamisinizantamisiningentamycine <c>, l'ampicilline et la gentamicine</c> lajɛlájɛvregarderlámrphCAUSjɛ́vblanchir .

Ni kanjabana ye a tigi minɛ k'a sɔrɔ sumaya wali sɔgɔsɔgɔninjɛ bɛ a la, i b'o bana furakɛ fana.Niniprepsi kanjabanakánjabananméningitekánncoujàvsécherbànanmaladie yeyepmPFV.TR aàpers3SG tigitìginmaître minɛmìnɛvattraper k'k'pmINF aàpers3SG sɔrɔsɔ̀rɔvobtenir sumayasúmayanfroidsúmavqfraisyamrphDEQU waliwáliconjou.bien sɔgɔsɔgɔninjɛsɔ̀gɔsɔgɔninjɛntuberculosesɔ̀gɔsɔgɔntouxninmrphDIMjɛ́adjblanc bɛbɛ́copêtre aàpers3SG laláppà , iípers2SG b'b'pmIPFV.AFF oòprnce banabànanmaladie furakɛfúrakɛvsoignerfúranfeuillekɛ́vfaire fanafánaprtaussi . Ni sumaya bɛ kunsɛmɛ na, ka kunnafoni sɔrɔ olu kan, gafe ɲɛ Kunsɛmɛnasumayabana juguman lajɛ.Niníconjsi sumayasúmayanfroidsúmavqfraisyamrphDEQU bɛbɛ́copêtre kunsɛmɛkùnsɛmɛncerveaukùnntêtesɛ́mɛnmoelle nanáppà , kakàpmINF kunnafonikùnnafonininformationkùnntêteláppàfónivdétacher sɔrɔsɔ̀rɔvobtenir oluòlûpersce.PL2òprncelumrphPL2 kankànppsur , gafegáfenlivre ɲɛɲɛ́noeil Kunsɛmɛnasumayabanakùnsɛmɛnasumayabanankùnsɛmɛncerveaukùnntêtesɛ́mɛnmoellenáppàsúmayabananpaludismesúmayanfroidbànanmaladie jugumanjúgumanadjméchantjúguvqméchantmanmrphADJ lajɛlájɛvregarderlámrphCAUSjɛ́vblanchir . Ni sɔgɔsɔgɔninjɛ don, aw ye sɛbɛn ɲɛ Sɔgɔsɔgɔnijɛ lajɛ.Niniprepsi sɔgɔsɔgɔninjɛsɔ̀gɔsɔgɔninjɛntuberculosesɔ̀gɔsɔgɔntouxninmrphDIMjɛ́adjblanc dondòncopID , awáwpers2PL.EMPH yeyépmIMP sɛbɛnsɛ́bɛnnécrit ɲɛɲɛ́noeil Sɔgɔsɔgɔnijɛsɔ̀gɔsɔgɔninjɛntuberculosesɔ̀gɔsɔgɔntouxninmrphDIMjɛ́adjblanc lajɛlájɛvregarderlámrphCAUSjɛ́vblanchir .

Galakanɔrɔ (fogonfogonnabana):Galakanɔrɔgálakanɔrɔnpneumoniegálakancôtenɔ́rɔvcoller ( fogonfogonnabanafógonfogonnabananfógonfogonnpoumonnáppàbànanmaladie ):

Sɔgɔsɔgɔ, mura, ani ninakili bɔli gɛlɛyaw bɛ se ka kɛ ka dan hakɛ la walima ka juguya.Sɔgɔsɔgɔsɔ̀gɔsɔgɔntoux , muramúranrhume , aniàníconjainsi.que ninakilinínakilinrespirationnínâmenákilivappelerlámrphCAUSkílivappeler bɔlibɔ́linsortiebɔ́vsortirlimrphNMLZ gɛlɛyawgɛ̀lɛyawngɛ̀lɛyanduretégɛ̀lɛnvqdifficileyamrphDEQUwmrphPL bɛbɛpmIPFV.AFF sesévarriver kakàpmINF kɛkɛ́vfaire kakàpmINF dandànvs'arrêter hakɛhákɛnmesure laláppà walimawàlímàconjou.bien kakàpmINF juguyajúguyavêtre.méchantjúguvqméchantyamrphDEQU . U la juguman dɔ ye galakanɔrɔ ye, ale min ye fogonfogonnabana ye.Uùpers3PL laláppà jugumanjúgumannméchancetéjúguvqméchantmanmrphADJ dɔdɔ́dtmcertain yeyécopEQU galakanɔrɔgálakanɔrɔnpneumoniegálakancôtenɔ́rɔvcoller yeyéppPP , aleàlêpers3SG.EMPH minmîndtmREL yeyécopEQU fogonfogonnabanafógonfogonnabananfógonfogonnpoumonnáppàbànanmaladie yeyéppPP . Galakanɔrɔ ɲɛfɔra k'a fɛsɛfɛsɛ sɛbɛn ɲɛ Kɛnɛya tigilamɔgɔw tɔgɔlakibaruya la.Galakanɔrɔgálakanɔrɔnpneumoniegálakancôtenɔ́rɔvcoller ɲɛfɔraɲɛ́fɔravɲɛ́fɔvexpliquerɲɛ́noeilfɔ́vdireramrphPFV.INTR k'k'pmINF aàpers3SG fɛsɛfɛsɛfɛ́sɛfɛsɛvfaire.une.action.avec.soin sɛbɛnsɛ́bɛnnécrit ɲɛɲɛ́noeil Kɛnɛyakɛ́nɛyanbonne.santékɛ́nɛvqsainyamrphDEQU tigilamɔgɔwtìgilamɔgɔwntìgilamɔgɔnpersonne.de.sortetìginmaîtreláppàmɔ̀gɔnhommewmrphPL tɔgɔlakibaruyatɔ́gɔlakibaruyantɔ́gɔnnomláppàkìbaruyannouvellekìbarunnouvelleyamrphABSTR laláppà . Ni denyɛrɛni b'a kalo 2 fɔlɔ kɔnɔ: ɲɔnni kɛli ka tɛmɛ fo siɲɛ 60 kan sanga kelen kɔnɔ; Ka bɔ a kalo 2 la ka se a kalo 12 ma: a ka caya ni ɲɔnko 50 ye sanga kɔnɔ; Ka bɔ kalo 12 la ka se san 5 ma: a ka caya ni ɲɔnko 40 ye sanga kɔnɔ.Niníconjsi denyɛrɛnidényɛ̀rɛninnbébédénnenfantninmrphDIM b'b'copêtre aàpers3SG kalokálonlune 22numCARDINAL fɔlɔfɔ́lɔadjpremier kɔnɔkɔ́nɔppdans : ɲɔnniɲɔ́nninɲɔ́nvrespirerlimrphNMLZ kɛlikɛ́linactionkɛ́vfairelimrphNMLZ kakapmSBJV tɛmɛtɛ̀mɛvpasser fofóconjjusqu'à siɲɛsìɲɛnpassènnjambeɲɛ́nfois 6060numCARDINAL kankànppsur sangasángantemps kelenkélennumun kɔnɔkɔ́nɔppdans ; KakàpmINF bɔbɔ́vsortir aàpers3SG kalokálonlune 22numCARDINAL laláppà kakàpmINF sesévarriver aàpers3SG kalokálonlune 1212numCARDINAL mamàppADR : aàpers3SG kakapmSBJV cayacáyavmultipliercávqnombreuxyamrphDEQU niniconjet ɲɔnkoɲɔ́nkonɲɔ́nnrespirationkónaffaire 5050numCARDINAL yeyéppPP sangasángantemps kɔnɔkɔ́nɔppdans ; KakàpmINF bɔbɔ́vsortir kalokálonlune 1212numCARDINAL laláppà kakàpmINF sesévarriver sansànnannée 55numCARDINAL mamàppADR : aàpers3SG kakapmSBJV cayacáyavmultipliercávqnombreuxyamrphDEQU niniconjet ɲɔnkoɲɔ́nkonɲɔ́nnrespirationkónaffaire 4040numCARDINAL yeyéppPP sangasángantemps kɔnɔkɔ́nɔppdans .
